_comment: Claude Code front-door MCP config for the Governed Agentic Companion. Collaboration surfaces (Jira/Confluence/GitHub) are read+write for human-reviewed artifacts; AWS is read-only (target state); the governed engine is reached through the `companion-engine` server. Use ONE companion-engine transport: the AgentCore Gateway HTTP endpoint (shown here) OR the local stdio bridge (see frontdoor/mcp.example.json). Fill ${...} from your gitignored env; never commit real endpoints, ARNs, tokens, or account ids. Every companion-engine response is already gated in the cloud (Tenets 1/3/4).

companion-engine._comment: Governed engine via the AgentCore Gateway. GAC_GATEWAY_URL is the FULL path-based invocations URL, e.g. https://<gateway-id>.gateway.bedrock-agentcore.<region>.amazonaws.com/companion-engine/invocations (NOT just the gateway host); GAC_GATEWAY_TOKEN is a valid enterprise-IdP JWT (Cognito user-client token in the reference deployment). Exposes ask_companion/companion_kb; responses are gated in the cloud. ALTERNATIVE: swap this entry for the local stdio bridge from frontdoor/mcp.example.json (option A) when the gateway is not stood up. Fill both env vars from your gitignored env; never commit a real URL or token.
